import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import glob,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
L='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/expanded-corpus-r533'
C='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus/mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl'
ids=json.load(open(L+'/reservation.json'))['ids']
want=set(ids)
dec=json.JSONDecoder()
def parse_top(s):
    i=s.index('{')+1; out={}
    def ws(i):
        while s[i] in ' \t': i+=1
        return i
    i=ws(i)
    while s[i]!='}':
        k,j=dec.raw_decode(s,i); j=ws(j); assert s[j]==':'; j=ws(j+1)
        v,e=dec.raw_decode(s,j); out[k]=(j,e,v); i=ws(e)
        if s[i]==',': i=ws(i+1)
    return out
res={}
files=sorted(glob.glob(C))
print('chunks',len(files))
first=True
for f in files:
    b=open(f,'rb').read(); fh=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
    lines=b.splitlines(keepends=True)
    for n,raw in enumerate(lines,1):
        if first:
            print('KEYS',list(json.loads(raw).keys())); first=False
        if not any(str(i).encode() in raw[:200] for i in want): continue
        o=json.loads(raw)
        mid=o.get('mathdb_id') or o.get('id')
        if mid in want:
            text=raw.rstrip(b'\n').decode('utf-8')
            t=parse_top(text)
            key=[k for k in ('statement','literal','body','statement_text') if k in t]
            assert key,list(t)
            k=key[0]; a,e,v=t[k]; tok=text[a:e]
            res[str(mid)]={'chunk':f,'chunk_sha256':fh,'line_one_based':n,'raw_line_with_newline_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'raw_line_bytes':len(raw),'ends_with_newline':raw.endswith(b'\n'),'statement_key':k,'raw_statement_token':tok,'raw_statement_token_sha256':hashlib.sha256(tok.encode()).hexdigest(),'decoded_statement':v,'decoded_statement_sha256':hashlib.sha256(v.encode()).hexdigest(),'raw_line':raw.decode('utf-8'),'other_keys':[x for x in t if x!=k]}
print(len(res), sorted(set(ids)-set(map(int,res))))
ordered={str(i):res[str(i)] for i in ids}
txt=json.dumps(ordered,indent=1,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n'
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',L+'/write_lane.py','literal-bindings.json'],input=txt,text=True,capture_output=True)
print(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
for i in ids[:7]:
    d=ordered[str(i)]
    print('#####',i,'chunk',d['chunk'].split('/')[-1],'line',d['line_one_based'],'nl',d['ends_with_newline'],'keys',d['other_keys'])
    print(d['decoded_statement'])
